lines: d42: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Bridget Meyer is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d42: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d42: 🕯️ Bridget Meyer is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
